# UI Automation MCP Extension Notes

This extension packages the UIAutomationMcp MCP server and CLI for VS Code.

When editing this area:
- keep package metadata aligned with `uia-mcp`
- ensure bundled binaries remain `UIAutomationMcp.McpServer.exe` and `uiamcp.exe`
- prefer `npm run compile` for code-only checks
- run `npm run package` after packaging or bundle changes
